messages:
alice: Quick sync — I sketched a PRD/RFC for the compliance initiative: audit logs + KMS/HSM options + retention policy. Need signoff on launch criteria and a list of edge cases to call out.
ben: thanks — can you drop the link? want to check what we promised to customers re: HSM?
alice: https://docs.internal/redwood/prd/compliance-rfc-draft (draft) — TL;DR: SOC2 + ISO evidence, configurable retention (30/90/365), optional external HSM integration, immutable audit stream, key rotation audit.
carol: quick note — for private deployments we need to confirm KMS key export rules. if a customer requests key-escrow, does that change acceptance?
ben: notable edge case: cross-region failover with HSM-backed keys. if primary region fails, we need rotation/fallback plan without exposing key material. acceptance should require documented fallback flow.
dave: also: retention exceptions for legal holds. product side needs API to tag sessions/logs as "legal_hold" so ops can prevent deletion.
security-bot: /uploaded RFC: compliance-keystore-hsm-ops-v1.pdf (artifact id: A-8932)
alice: good — propose launch criteria: 1) automated end-to-end test proving immutable audit writes (no tamper), 2) KMS plugin validated with at least 1 cloud KMS + 1 HSM partner, 3) retention controls with legal_hold flag + retention export for audits, 4) SOC2 evidence pack generation.
ben: +1 but add: perf guardrails — audit ingestion must not add >10ms p99 to inference calls (or we should support async ingestion).
carol: edge case: large-batch embedding jobs will emit many audit events — need quota/batching and TTL semantics. make sure PRD covers batching and cost implications.
dave: ops note: we need an admin console view with per-tenant retention setting and export UI for auditors. also include logs for key rotation events (who rotated, when, old key id).
alice: agreed. minor UX ask: default retention should be 90d for hosted, 365d for enterprise, explicit opt-in for longer.
ben: question on HSM: do we support BYO-HSM network tunnels? that affects network topology section of PRD. if yes, add network diagrams and firewall rules.
alice: will add. also calling out acceptance criteria for HSM: 3rd party attestation + key usage audit events present in stream.
carol: don't forget GDPR/data-subject deletion flows: if a user requests deletion, audit entries referencing personal data must be redacted while preserving cryptographic integrity. tricky.
dave: propose: redact sensitive fields at write-time, store redaction-proof hash so we can prove tamper-resistance without storing PII. add as an edge case in PRD.
ben: sample acceptance test snippet to validate immutability:
```
# simulate tamper: write -> snapshot -> attempt overwrite -> verify snapshot unchanged
POST /audit/events {"event":"inference","id":"1234"}
GET /audit/snapshot/1234 -> sha256:abc
# attempt write again -> should reject
```
carol: also include retention export format for auditors: CSV + signed manifest (sha256) + human-readable summary.
alice: next steps: ben to update infra section (perf + HSM network), carol to add GDPR/retention edgecases, dave to draft admin UI acceptance tests. I'll merge into RFC by EOD Fri. reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:
ben: will do. one more ask — add SLA language around audit availability and backup window for dedicated customers.
security-bot: note: compliance review requested — owners set to alice, ben, carol. review deadline: 7 days.
alice: thanks all — posting final checklist in PRD when merged.
